description: Whack-a-Mole — moles pop up at random for 30 seconds. Whack as many as you can and chase the high score.

faqs.a: You have 30 seconds. Each mole you whack scores 1 point (golden moles score 3 but vanish fast).
Moles appear faster and in greater numbers as the clock runs down.
Your best score is saved in this browser.

howto: Tap moles as they pop up (golden ones are worth 3).
Watch the timer — moles speed up near the end.
title: Whack-a-Mole Game
